comment: Phase 3 of LughOS — task lifecycle (A), transactional storage (C), MMU/memory protection (B), JEPA-prep telemetry (J). Phase 3 D (wire SYS_IPC_SEND under user_init_task) shipped previously as commit 6552229 and is intentionally not included here.

tasks.title: Unify scheduler task table with kernel task table — drop rr_tasks[64], rr_* operates on kernel/sched/task.c table
Per-task kernel stacks: static kernel_stacks[MAX_RUNNABLE][16384] + task_t.kernel_stack_top (struct grows)
SYS_CREATE_TASK + SYS_YIELD + repurpose SYS_EXIT to mark TERMINATED + reschedule
Preemptive context switch on PIT/SP804 tick: arm_/x86_context_switch + current_task swap inside the switch with IRQs masked
test_task_lifecycle: spawn 2-3 children, yield round-robin, deliberate SYS_EXIT reduces live count; move test_task_caps above the IRQ unmask
storage_ops_t interface mirroring scheduler_ops_t + memory_storage_ops concrete instance; paths treated as opaque keys (no FS)
Bounded global txn_log[TXN_LOG_ENTRIES=256] ring with task_id field; overflow → auditor OVERFLOW record
generate_transaction_id() atomic via IPL raise (ARM) / cli-sti (x86); panic on uint64 wrap
create_checkpoint / restore_checkpoint via reserved checkpoint_slots[][] byte arrays keyed by path string
test_transactional_storage: 1000-id distinctness test + 4KB checkpoint round-trip verification
Page frame allocator with static frame_table[NFRAMES]; per-arch device window identification
Real x86 2-level page tables: kernel PD at boot, identity-map kernel+VGA+PIC+PIT, load CR3 + enable CR0.PG (atomic single commit)
ARMv5 single TTBR0 page tables: identity-map kernel+stacks+devices+vectors, DACR=0x55555555, caches+TLB invalidate, write TTBR0, SCTLR.M (atomic — half-MMU is unbootable)
Real allocate_page_dir + map_user_space + TLB invalidation; task_t.page_dir_phys; context switch loads CR3/TTBR0 from new task; update SYS_WRITE/SYS_IPC_SEND user-VA range to match new mappings
RISC-V MMU stub hooks for compile parity — make riscv passes; runtime path no-op
test_mmu_protection: map user page read-only, deliberate write triggers data abort, kernel handler logs MMU_FAULT and terminates the offending task without taking the system down
Record parent_task_id on task_t at create_task time; sentinel 0xFFFFFFFF for kernel_task (no parent)
AUDITOR_REC_TASK_CREATE record type (=4); bump AUDITOR_TELEMETRY_VERSION; emit from create_task; update read_telemetry.py decoder atomically
AUDITOR_REC_CHAN_CREATE record type (=5); emit from ipc_create_channel; fields: channel_id, owner_task_id, cap_mask, domain, protocol
AUDITOR_REC_CHAN_CONNECT record type (=6); emit from ipc_connect on success; fields: src_channel, dst_channel, src_domain, dst_domain
AUDITOR_REC_TASK_EXIT record type (=7); emit from SYS_EXIT handler (depends on A3 making SYS_EXIT a real lifecycle event)
Include parent_task_id in DENY records (auditor_deny_info_t gains field); update emit_deny + emit_create_deny + Python decoder
Add lineage_depth + sibling_count to DENY records; bounded ancestor walk + bounded sibling scan; encodes structural position for the JEPA encoder

Domain transition matrix replaces flat CAP_CROSS_DOMAIN; static domain_edges[MAX_DOMAINS] bitmap (identity default); CAP_CROSS_DOMAIN survives as bypass; emit AUDITOR_REC_DOMAIN_EDGE on policy mutation
test_telemetry_completeness: validates the exact expected set of structural records appears in the stream for a known boot sequence; counts MSG/DENY/TASK_CREATE/CHAN_CREATE/CHAN_CONNECT/TASK_EXIT
scripts/reconstruct_graph.py: consume event stream → reconstruct task+channel+domain graph at any timestamp; DOT output for sanity-check visualization
